name: r6-contact-pair-control
description: THE CONTACT PAIR v2, arm 2 of 3 — `noDamage: TRUE`, ONE FIELD apart from `r6-contact-pair-live` and identical in every other byte. `Player.hit`'s first line is `if (Bot.noDamage) return`, so the guard buys no sound, no shake, no `hits`, no i-frames, no knockback and no `die()`: the player walks straight through the trap's body and keeps walking east for all 130 ticks. This is the arm that makes the other one evidence — without it, 'the model reproduces the damage' and 'the model reproduces a walk that was never damaged' print the same green.
